caption:
Softening your words can feel nice in the moment. It usually just makes the other person do more guessing.

Save this for the next talk you keep almost having.

#newmanager #firsttimemanager #leadership #managertips #feedback

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “No pressure, but I need this today.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “There is pressure. I just feel bad saying it.”

messages.name: You say
messages.text: “Something felt a little off in that meeting.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “You interrupted me twice in front of the team.”

messages.name: You mean
messages.text: “This is not tiny, and I should say it straight.”

slides.headline: Mixed signals make <u>work</u> harder
slides.sub: Say the real thing, with a calm tone.
